name: pickup_select_puppies_zrd_by_difficulty
description: Pickup::SelectPuppiesZrdByDifficulty selects a difficulty-specific puppies ZRD when it can be resolved, otherwise falling back to puppies.zrd.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Pickup mission-load/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41ddf0 validates fastcall ECX=extraSearchPath, zOpt::GetGameDifficultyMode, selecting puppies_easy.zrd for difficulty 0, puppies_hard.zrd for difficulty 2, puppies.zrd otherwise, probing the selected filename through zReader::TryResolvePath, and returning puppies.zrd when the selected filename cannot be resolved.
The native smoke verifies easy selection through an extra search path, hard fallback when puppies_hard.zrd is missing, hard selection when present, and default difficulty selection.
